title: Director of Information Security
summary: A director of information security runs the security programme day to day, usually reporting to the CISO or CTO. They lead several security managers, keep the company in line with ISO 27001 and RBI, SEBI or CERT-In rules, handle audits and serious incidents, and turn the CISO's strategy into a roadmap that teams deliver.
dailyDuties: Run the security roadmap and track delivery across teams
Review the cyber risk register and agree fixes with owners
Lead response to serious incidents and regulator reporting
Prepare for ISO 27001, RBI or SEBI audits and close findings
Lead and hire security managers across SOC, engineering and GRC
Report security metrics to the CISO and risk committee
typicalTitles: Director - Data Privacy and Information Security

skills.expectation: Run the information security programme and roadmap for the CISO
Keep the cyber risk register and drive risk treatment
Meet RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and CERT-In cyber directions and inspections
Run the ISMS against ISO 27001 and NIST CSF
Set security standards for cloud, identity and networks
Lead response to serious incidents and regulator reporting
Handle internal, external and regulator audits and close findings
Lead security managers across SOC, engineering and GRC
Work with IT, business heads and the CISO
Prepare cyber risk updates for the risk committee
Oversee vendor and cloud security reviews
Work with the DPO on the DPDP Act
Plan and track the security budget

certifications.why: Indian employer posts for security directors ask for CISSP.
Common for security managers moving into leadership.
Some posts list CISA as well.
